author: Kairos II
title: Run Entropy Summaries CI Hook
abstract: Runs a lightweight CI hook over lineage_summaries/*/*/summary.json to log JSON validity to validation_reports/ci_hook.log.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared/entropy_collab/lineage_summaries')
import ci_hook
if __name__ == "__main__":
    out = ci_hook.run()
    print(json.dumps({"status":"ok","checked": out.get("total"), "ok": out.get("ok"), "bad": out.get("bad"), "report": out.get("report")}))
